statements:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
    version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE roles (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    code public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE users (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    role_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    username public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    last_login_at TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE material_categories (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    code public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1))
)

CREATE TABLE material_projects (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    code public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE warehouses (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    code public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE locations (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    code public.citext NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    UNIQUE (warehouse_id, code)
)

CREATE TABLE materials (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    code public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specification TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    category_id INTEGER ,
    brand TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    unit TEXT NOT NULL,
    minimum_stock NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (minimum_stock >= 0),
    default_warehouse_id INTEGER ,
    default_location_id INTEGER ,
    require_batch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (require_batch IN (0, 1)),
    require_serial INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (require_serial IN (0, 1)),
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
, unit_usage NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (unit_usage >= 0), processing_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE material_bom_items (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    product_material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    parent_item_id INTEGER ,
    component_material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (quantity > 0),
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    source_sheet TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    source_row INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE business_documents (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    document_no public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    document_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    stock_direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stock_direction IN ('IN', 'OUT', 'TRANSFER', 'ADJUST')),
    document_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'POSTED', 'PARTIALLY_REVERSED', 'REVERSED')),
    source_document_id INTEGER ,
    handler_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    posted_at TEXT,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
, production_run_id INTEGER , submission_token public.citext, supplier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE business_document_items (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    document_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    line_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    reversed_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reversed_quantity >= 0),
    returned_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (returned_quantity >= 0),
    batch_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    warehouse_id INTEGER ,
    location_id INTEGER ,
    target_warehouse_id INTEGER ,
    target_location_id INTEGER ,
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', source_item_id INTEGER , ordered_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ordered_quantity >= 0), gift_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (gift_quantity >= 0), reversed_gift_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reversed_gift_quantity >= 0),
    UNIQUE (document_id, line_number),
    CHECK (reversed_quantity <= quantity),
    CHECK (returned_quantity <= quantity)
)

CREATE TABLE stock_balances (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    location_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    batch_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity >= 0),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    UNIQUE (material_id, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_no)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory_ledger (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    business_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    document_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    batch_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    serial_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    quantity_in NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_in >= 0),
    quantity_out NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_out >= 0),
    quantity_before NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_before >= 0),
    quantity_after NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_after >= 0),
    warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    location_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    operator_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    reversal_of_ledger_id INTEGER ,
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    CHECK ((quantity_in > 0 AND quantity_out = 0) OR (quantity_out > 0 AND quantity_in = 0))
)

CREATE TABLE batches (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    batch_no TEXT NOT NULL,
    supplier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    first_in_at TEXT,
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE (material_id, batch_no)
)

CREATE TABLE serial_numbers (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    serial_no public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    batch_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('IN_STOCK', 'OUTBOUND', 'CONSUMED', 'SCRAPPED', 'VOIDED')),
    warehouse_id INTEGER ,
    location_id INTEGER ,
    production_batch TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inbound_at TEXT,
    outbound_at TEXT,
    last_document_id INTEGER ,
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE inventory_ledger_serials (
    ledger_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    serial_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    PRIMARY KEY (ledger_id, serial_id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory_counts (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    document_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE ,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED')),
    confirmed_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE inventory_count_items (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    inventory_count_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    location_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    batch_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    system_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    actual_quantity NUMERIC,
    difference_quantity NUMERIC,
    difference_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE attachments (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    business_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    business_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    original_file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    mime_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (file_size >= 0),
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    file_data BYTEA NOT NULL,
    uploaded_by INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_deleted IN (0, 1)),
    deleted_by INTEGER ,
    deleted_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE document_forms (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    document_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    form_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'
        CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'COMPLETED')),
    last_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attachment_id INTEGER ,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    UNIQUE (document_id, form_kind)
)

CREATE TABLE issue_line_options (
    document_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
        ,
    external_dispatch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (external_dispatch IN (0, 1)),
    secondary_dispatch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (secondary_dispatch IN (0, 1)),
    loss_marked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (loss_marked IN (0, 1)),
    return_to_stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (return_to_stock IN (0, 1))
)

CREATE TABLE issue_line_usage (
    document_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
        ,
    unit_usage NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT -1
        CHECK (unit_usage >= -1)
)

CREATE TABLE inspection_notices (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    inspection_no public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'
        CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'QUALIFIED', 'UNQUALIFIED', 'USED', 'CANCELLED')),
    notification_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    arrival_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    entrusted_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    notification_department TEXT NOT NULL,
    urgency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL'
        CHECK (urgency IN ('EXPEDITED', 'URGENT', 'NORMAL')),
    purchase_order_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    supplier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inspector_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inspection_date TEXT,
    inspection_result TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'
        CHECK (inspection_result IN ('PENDING', 'QUALIFIED', 'UNQUALIFIED')),
    conclusion TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inspection_attachment_id INTEGER ,
    template_file_attachment_id INTEGER ,
    template_payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    archive_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    linked_document_id INTEGER UNIQUE ,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    updated_by INTEGER ,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    completed_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE inspection_notice_items (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    notice_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    line_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_number > 0),
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    purchase_order_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    batch_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    supplier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', qualified_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (qualified_quantity >= 0), unqualified_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (unqualified_quantity >= 0), inbound_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (inbound_quantity >= 0),
    UNIQUE (notice_id, line_number)
)

CREATE TABLE inbound_inspection_details (
    document_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ,
    requires_inspection INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (requires_inspection IN (0, 1)),
    inspection_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inspection_date TEXT,
    inspector_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inspection_result TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_REQUIRED'
        CHECK (inspection_result IN ('NOT_REQUIRED', 'PENDING', 'QUALIFIED', 'UNQUALIFIED')),
    conclusion TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inspection_attachment_id INTEGER 
, inspection_notice_id INTEGER )

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER ,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_id INTEGER,
    detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE production_runs (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_no public.citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    product_material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    product_model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    planned_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (planned_quantity > 0),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN' CHECK (status IN ('OPEN', 'COMPLETED')),
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE role_permissions (
    role_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    permission_code public.citext NOT NULL,
    is_allowed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_allowed IN (0, 1)),
    PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission_code)
)

CREATE TABLE material_images (
    material_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ,
    original_file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    mime_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    image_data BYTEA NOT NULL,
    updated_by INTEGER ,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE sales_outbound_details (
    document_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ,
    customer_company TEXT NOT NULL,
    destination TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    contact_phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    sales_order_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    logistics_company TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    tracking_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
, delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', receipt_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'
        CHECK (receipt_status IN ('PENDING', 'SIGNED')), receipt_date TEXT, receipt_attachment_id INTEGER , receipt_confirmed_by INTEGER , receipt_confirmed_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE inspection_results (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    notice_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    inspection_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    inspector_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    conclusion TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attachment_id INTEGER ,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    updated_by INTEGER ,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')),
    UNIQUE (notice_id, sequence_no)
)

CREATE TABLE inspection_result_items (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    result_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    notice_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    line_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_number > 0),
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL ,
    material_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    material_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    specification TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    batch_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    inspected_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (inspected_quantity >= 0),
    qualified_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (qualified_quantity >= 0),
    unqualified_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (unqualified_quantity >= 0),
    UNIQUE (result_id, line_number)
)

CREATE TABLE system_identity (
    singleton_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton_id = 1),
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
)

CREATE TABLE number_rules (
    document_type TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    prefix TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    current_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (current_sequence >= 0),
    sequence_width INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4 CHECK (sequence_width BETWEEN 2 AND 8)
)
CREATE INDEX idx_materials_name ON materials(name)

CREATE INDEX idx_material_bom_product_parent
    ON material_bom_items(product_material_id, parent_item_id, sort_order, id)

CREATE INDEX idx_material_bom_component
    ON material_bom_items(component_material_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_documents_date_type ON business_documents(document_date, document_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_material_time ON inventory_ledger(material_id, occurred_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_document ON inventory_ledger(document_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_stock_location ON stock_balances(warehouse_id, location_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_serial_material_status ON serial_numbers(material_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_attachments_business ON attachments(business_type, business_id, is_deleted)

CREATE INDEX idx_document_forms_document_status
    ON document_forms(document_id, status)

CREATE INDEX idx_inspection_notices_status_date
    ON inspection_notices(status, notification_date DESC, id DESC)

CREATE INDEX idx_inspection_notice_items_notice
    ON inspection_notice_items(notice_id, line_number)

CREATE INDEX idx_inbound_inspection_result
    ON inbound_inspection_details(requires_inspection, inspection_result)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_documents_submission_token
    ON business_documents(submission_token)
    WHERE submission_token IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX idx_documents_production_run
    ON business_documents(production_run_id, document_type, document_date)

CREATE INDEX idx_items_source_item
    ON business_document_items(source_item_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_role_permissions_code ON role_permissions(permission_code, is_allowed)
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_logs_created_at ON audit_logs(created_at DESC)

CREATE INDEX idx_material_projects_active
    ON material_projects(is_active, code)

CREATE INDEX idx_documents_reporting
    ON business_documents(document_date, document_type, stock_direction)

CREATE INDEX idx_items_material_document
    ON business_document_items(material_id, document_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_sales_outbound_customer
    ON sales_outbound_details(customer_company)

CREATE INDEX idx_sales_outbound_order
    ON sales_outbound_details(sales_order_no)

CREATE INDEX idx_sales_outbound_receipt_status
    ON sales_outbound_details(receipt_status, receipt_date DESC)

CREATE INDEX idx_inbound_inspection_notice
    ON inbound_inspection_details(inspection_notice_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_inbound_inspection_no
    ON inbound_inspection_details(inspection_no)
    WHERE inspection_no <> ''

CREATE INDEX idx_inspection_results_notice
    ON inspection_results(notice_id, sequence_no)

CREATE INDEX idx_inspection_result_items_result
    ON inspection_result_items(result_id, line_number)
